verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the subscriptions doc, which says a subscription can include coupons and discounts. That covers the coupon part of the story only thinly. Nothing in the pack documents free trials, promotion codes, automatic trial-to-paid conversion, or card-network trial-end notifications. Missing for 10: free-trial configuration, promotion/coupon codes, automatic trial-to-paid conversion, trial-end reminder notifications for card-network compliance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
